title: Password warning during repository setup
text: If Git needs a password for the repository check, setup shows an amber warning and explains that cloning may still work. The info button explains why the check cannot ask for a password. You can still choose Clone and create project to use saved credentials.
chapters: See why the check needs a password

more.title: Setup uses your Git SSH configuration
more.text: When you set up a project from an SSH repository, Seismic uses the SSH command Git selects to check access and clone. That lets setup use a configured identity or jump host.
chapters: Check an SSH repository with its configured identity
Clone with the same SSH transport
